items.title: Exhaustive decomposition of arbitrary finitely presented multiparameter modules with a repeated-degree parameter
items.author: Tamal K. Dey; Jan Jendrysiak; Michael Kerber
items.source_version: arXiv:2504.08119v2, submitted 2025-11-22; complete author TeX source retrieved 2026-10-13
items.difficulty_reason: The counted object includes the general repeated-degree decomposition algorithm and its complexity theorem. The substantive step is reduction from invertible change-of-basis matrices to Grassmannian subspaces, exploiting complementary-space equivalence and Schubert cells before recursive splitting. The final bound records this construction as a parameter-dependent algorithm for all finite-field presentations; it is distinct from the interval-only cubic algorithm.
